topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When the delivery van pulled up, I knew before even checking that something was amiss. The package, wrapped in standard brown, had a name on it I couldn’t place. Not mine, nor anyone I recognized. Curious, I opened it, revealing a beautifully crafted wooden box inside. The craftsmanship was impeccable, something I would have designed myself had I the talent. I reached out to the sender to let them know of the mix-up, and they were not only grateful but insisted I keep the box for my trouble. It now sits on my coffee table, a testament to unexpected generosity and the simple pleasure of a mistake turned into something special.
